title: Find the tipping point in phase-change materials
hook: Many systems change gradually until one threshold causes a disproportionate shift. This prompt asks where that threshold might be.
experiment: Use a bounded stored-energy reserve as a first-order thermal-storage proxy. Vary storage capacity, replenishment and changing heat demand; measure the share of time demand is fully served.
question: Can a building stay comfortable with less active cooling?
caveat: The current resource model is only a storage-and-demand analogy; it does not simulate temperature, heat transfer, phase change or measured material properties.
